Maya (Sales): Quick heads-up — Northridge Health just asked for SOC 2 Type 2 excerpts, a signed pen-test attestation, and confirmation we can provide a dedicated staging environment for their external scan. They want this before we finalize Dedicated pricing.
Carlos (SE): Do we have a standard pen-test attestation template we can sign? They want a specific signatory (CISO-level) and a window for testing.
Priya (Security): We have a pen-test attestation template used for enterprise deals, but legal signs off on the signatory. Also need to confirm we can grant short-lived staging IPs and KMS separation for the test.
Maya (Sales): Timeline: customer wants evidence by EOD next Tue to meet procurement. Pricing hold unless we confirm staging access + signed attestation.
Liam (Product): For Dedicated POCs we can spin a tenant with network isolation. Ops would need an IP whitelist and a burst cap. Any constraints on SMPC/KMS?
Priya (Security): KMS: we can provide a customer-scoped KMS key in staging with audit logs, but only for ephemeral creds. If they insist on key material control we need Private deployment. Mention that.
Carlos (SE): For the pen test itself, we should require scope & allowed vectors. We can offer a read-only snapshot of logs during the window. Also ask if they need source-code-level access — we don't provide that.
Maya (Sales): Can someone confirm the exact SOC 2 artefacts we can share? They specifically asked for "controls matrix excerpt + auditor cover page" and proof of remediation history.
Priya (Security): We can share the SOC 2 cover page and system description excerpt, plus a controls mapping spreadsheet redacted for customer-specific data. Remediation history can be summarized (dates & ticket refs) but not raw internal tickets. LMK if they need anything more specific.
Carlos (SE): Also FYI: Dedicated pricing changes if we open a dedicated staging pool for external scanning due to capacity & support SLA. I'll estimate delta once we know expected qps and test duration.
Maya (Sales): Customer asked if we can sign a 3rd-party NDA or a short SOW for the test. Legal is involved — Priya, can you loop legal?
Priya (Security): On it. I'll cc Legal and attach the attestation template. We should also require that the tester is named and insurance/SL cert attached.
Liam (Product): One more flag: if they request kernel/driver-level fuzzing or low-level benchmarks, we need an engineering review and a scheduled maintenance window. Otherwise normal app-layer scans are fine.
Maya (Sales): Action items: Priya -> attach attestation & SOC excerpts to customer; Carlos -> provide pricing delta for staging/test; Liam -> confirm ops runbook for isolated tenant & maintenance windows. I'll push procurement timeline.
Carlos (SE): I'll produce a short cost note: estimated +10% for reserved burst and ops support for a 48h external scan (ballpark). Will update by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): Drafting attestation now. deploy-bot: created ticket SEC-2026 for attestation + evidence handoff.
deploy-bot: Ticket SEC-2026 created: "Attestation & SOC2 excerpt for Northridge POC" assigned to Priya (Security). Priority: high.
Maya (Sales): Perfect — thanks all. I'll relay the dependencies back to the customer and ask them to confirm tester name + test scope. :thumbsup:
Carlos (SE): NOTE: add to the POC docs: how to safely provide presigned S3 assets for test data (we should avoid production data). I'll add a snippet.
Carlos (SE): ```
# example presign workflow
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/nhr-test-data.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
# only allow GET, narrow IP range
```
Maya (Sales): That'll help procurement sign off. Closing loop later today with the customer.
